Name: (AT) Wyrd's Seasonal Silos
Author: lianace
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds 2 silos, that have seasonal textures which will change based on the in-game seasons. There is a tall/regular height silo, and a shorter option. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20786]You can find the original mod for Content Patcher (default building replacement) here.[/url]

This is an AT mod, meaning the default buildings are not replaced. AT mods add extra options you can manually customize with the paint bucket tool from Robin's shop.

Credit goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/56947462]logwyrd [/url]for the textures, I just converted them to AT.[/size]
